why_v783: The LIF model's connectivity is v783. Root IDs are NOT portable across materialisations -- only ~76.6% of v783 IDs exist in v630, and DNa01_L does not exist in v630 at all. Never mix.

queries.ORN: super_class == 'sensory' AND class == 'olfactory' AND primary_type.startswith('ORN_')  # HRN_/TRN_ are hygro/thermo receptors, excluded
queries.DNa01/DNa02: primary_type == 'DNa01' | 'DNa02', side from the `side` column.  # MUST NOT key on hemibrain_type: cell_type=DNa01 carries hemibrain_type=VES006, while cell_type=DNae001 carries hemibrain_type=DNa01. Also MUST NOT take side from free-text labels, which are sometimes mirrored.

model_index_note: `indices` are column positions in the LIF model's tensors, derived as row order of 2025_Completeness_783.csv, matching upstream's flyid2i = {root_id: i for i, root_id in enumerate(df.index)}.
